lines.t: (Verse 1)
In the quiet of the dawn, I feel You near,
The voice that spoke before the earths sphere.
From dust You formed man,
And still Your mercy holds my hand.
You are the light that breaks my night,
The word that turns my darkness into light.
Every promise, tried and true,
Leads my heart to rest in You.
(Chorus)
YahuShua (echo: YahuShua…) You are holy,
King forever, Lord of Glory (echo: glory…).
In the pain, through the storm,
You are peace, You are my song.
YahuShua (echo: YahuShua…) Name above,
Endless truth, unending love.
Every heartbeat, all creation,
Praises You in life’s pulsation.
(Verse 2)
Your word is fire, pure and clear,
The still small voice that draws me near.
You walked the earth in humble grace,
And bore my sin in love’s embrace.
The veil was torn, the stone rolled back,
The Shepherd calling hearts aback.
The lost are found, the blind now see,
Your truth has set the captive free.
(Chorus)
YahuShua (echo: YahuShua…) You are holy,
King forever, Lord of Glory (echo: glory…).
In the pain, through the night,
You are peace, You are my song.
YahuShua (echo: YahuShua…) Name above,
Endless truth, unending love.
Every heartbeat, all creation,
Praises You in life’s pulsation.
(Bridge – worship build)
All creation bows before,
The Lamb of God forevermore.
He reigns in light, His word endures,
The heavens sing, “Your kingdom comes!”
And I will lift my hands in praise,
To the One who conquered the grave.
My soul will sing through endless days,
Your glory never fades away.
(Final Chorus – soaring)
YahuShua (echo: YahuShua…) You are holy,
King forever, Lord of Glory (echo: glory…).
In the pain, through the hurt,
You are peace, You are my song.
YahuShua (echo: YahuShua…) Name above,
Endless truth, unending love.
Every heartbeat, all creation,
Praises You in life’s pulsation.
Savior (echo: Savior…), Light of the morning, rise again,
Faithful Friend who never ends.
Till I stand before Your majesty,
No more worlds grip and agony
